status: Sampling frame and empty annotation forms only; human validation has not occurred
sampling: Within source x observed-hostility x within-source-label influence band (90/9/1 percent), take 3 smallest salted SHA256 ranks, or census if fewer than 3. Salt 687125 fixed before human annotation.
influence: Max absolute row influence divided by that coefficient influence RMS across 8 raw-count OLS, 8 occurrence OLS, and 8 PPML log-ratio coefficients in source-day full-release models; driver 0:7 count, 8:15 occurrence, 16:23 PPML in published channel order.
probabilities: Within every nonempty stratum, inclusion n_h/N_h under the hash pseudorandomization design; analysis weight N_h/n_h. Conditional on the fixed salt actual selection is deterministic. Report this reproducible sampling convention explicitly.
blinding: Annotation forms contain only random annotation_id and empty text/response fields. Keep key inaccessible to coders; populate text only after verified linkage by authorized data custodian. Do not expose labels, outcomes, influence, source or probability.
raw_text_requirement: No text is present in the public release. Exact original row-to-post-ID linkage and authorized raw post text must be obtained before these forms can be annotated. Never match on engagement alone, infer text, or substitute model outputs for human labels.
independence: Two Ukrainian/Russian fluent coders independently annotate every available sampled post after a separate training pilot. No discussion of study rows before both annotations are locked. Third adjudicator resolves disagreements, preserving original two labels.
rubric: Freeze the original supplementary codebook and translation rules before coding. Hostility means expressed hostility/derogation/dislike toward Russia or Russians; solidarity toward Ukraine/Ukrainians is coded separately. Preserve quoted speech, target, context ambiguity and unavailable cases explicitly.
analysis: Design-weighted joint confusion table, observed-positive correction rate and observed-negative correction rate overall and by influence band, source and calendar phase only where sample size permits; agreement before adjudication. Weighted sensitivity/specificity require a defensible adjudicated reference and nonresponse treatment. Report per-stratum effective n, missing text, agreement uncertainty and cluster dependence; no unweighted pooled accuracy claim from disproportionate sampling.
nonresponse: Do not silently replace unlinked or unavailable posts. Record reason; retain denominator, report linkage by stratum; report bounds or a declared nonresponse model. A second-stage sample requires its own probabilities.
limits: Three per source-label-influence stratum is an actionable audit sample, not a precision guarantee for all source-specific errors. Text retrieval may itself be selective. This is conditional validation of released labels and not a new outcome dataset.
original_validation: Original article DOI 10.1038/s41467-024-52179-8 reports 2000 labels by first author, 1600 training and 400 held-out testing with about .87 accuracy/.80 macro-F1; public host_val schema has no paired news NLI outputs or raw texts. Tuning notebook outputs cannot be reclassified as held-out validation.
row_reconciliation: Release-row SHA hashes identify rows in this exact release, not original platform IDs or the unknown 139 omitted cases. No reconciliation is claimed.
